Travel-skill 1.0.0 – AI-powered family travel planner debut

- Introduces a comprehensive family travel planning assistant focused on crowd avoidance, senior-friendly, and kid-friendly routes.
- Supports visual itinerary generation with balance for seniors, adults, and children, including built-in rest and activity recommendations.
- Integrates booking advice for tickets and hotels with policy checks and official links, without direct booking.
- Offers customized task cards for children and detailed packing/expense checklists.
- Supports English and Chinese (zh-CN & en) queries.
